external_games.name: Loop : Beginning Of Never Ending Journey

name: Loop
storyline: Beyond your memories lies a strange world that watches you… and never lets go once you enter it. You awaken without answers in a shifting world where reality bends and every escape leads deeper into the nightmare. Explore abandoned places, survive unsettling encounters, and solve environmental puzzles in this atmospheric 2.5D puzzle adventure where every new discovery only leads to more questions. Moments of silence slowly build into tension before collapsing into sudden chaos. What feels distant and lifeless one moment may become terrifying the next. Leaving no time to understand what is real anymore. But something is wrong with this world. Every corner hides something unexpected — disturbing creatures, shifting world, and mysteries that refuse to reveal the truth. The deeper you go, the more the world changes around you. And some memories were never meant to return. Hidden clues, fractured memories, and unsettling encounters slowly uncover a truth that never stays the same long enough to understand. Or perhaps the world was never meant to be understood at all. The world is alive… and it knows you are here. Some journeys were never meant to end. ZZ
summary: Wake up in a shifting world of forgotten memories that watches you back. Uncover the truth behind a reality where every escape leads to another nightmare. Something is wrong with this world… and somehow, you are part of it. A journey that you may never return from.
